title: Ferrous waste and scrap

review.classification: UNSD PDF p. 203 separates ferrous waste and scrap from scale and other residues in 39310 and remelting scrap ingots in 39350. An unremelted metallic sheet offcut preserves the specific scrap identity through controlled cold cutting and compression. The named pre-consumer grade gives a real narrower boundary.
review.route_and_receiver: The supplemental Steel Dynamics site original distinguishes loose busheling and compressing new sheet clippings in Grade 208 bundles. ReMA and Roanoke confirm the trade state and physically distinct grades. The specified HC340LA sheet family and uncoated state require actual certificate, lot trace and agreed receiver chemistry and bale limits. Published receiver specifications are supporting examples.
review.measurement_and_allocation: Reviewed both languages for primary net first-release mass with separate tare and packaging, measured transport tonne-km, original Q_c and stock/matched transfers including cancelled deliveries. Actual stamping results keep both stamped blank and scrap. Dedicated, causal and residual allocation only change environmental burdens. Physical conservation and zero-release behavior agree across languages.
review.native_and_bilingual: Matched exact pinned original bytes for four retained flow bindings and four referenced property or unit group supports. This establishes auxiliary archived support only. The exact reference flow and 23 auxiliary row bindings still require applicable current evidence. Confirmed equivalent English and Chinese product, gate, measurement and burden requirements.

sources.role: Mill original for HC340LA, the uncoated sheet supply case and adjacent coated variants.
Original ReMA specifications supporting distinctions between loose 207, new sheet 207A and compressed or bundled new sheet scrap in 208.
Receiving mill original, AP019 Rev. 2 at pp. 7–8. Explicit compressed #1 bundles and separate site acceptance requirements.
Additional site manual detailing physically distinct factory offcuts, loose grades and bundles.
